sourceNotes: Summarized from ISO fastener family references, manufacturer catalog conventions, and MISUMI-style mechanical design guidance.
Do not treat these as a substitute for final standard tables.

checks: Choose thread diameter from load, joint stiffness, available edge distance, and assembly access.
Prefer standard metric coarse threads for general machine assembly.
Use property class 8.8 or higher only when the joint calculation and mating material justify it.
Keep enough edge distance around clearance holes to avoid tearing or local yielding.
Slot holes should state adjustment direction and locking method.
Thread engagement in aluminum should be longer than in steel or use inserts.
Use spring washers, thread locker, lock nuts, or mechanical locking for vibration.
Mark high-vibration joints for maintenance inspection.
Avoid hidden fasteners that cannot be installed with standard tools.
